title: Comunicado 2025-05-15
summary: Banxico's Board unanimously cut the policy rate by 50bp to 8.50% and explicitly kept the door open to another cut of similar magnitude, while foreseeing that the inflation environment will allow the cutting cycle to continue, albeit with a restrictive stance. The justification leans on the weakness of activity (Q1 GDP up only 0.2% q/q after a contraction, with important downside risks from trade tensions), the peso's behavior and the still-high degree of restriction. Inflation concern is present but secondary: short-term forecasts were revised up on merchandise inflation and core rose at the margin, yet the balance of risks, though still tilted up, is judged to have improved and convergence to 3% is still expected in Q3 2026. Versus the March communique the message is essentially unchanged -- another large cut with the same continuation guidance -- so the Board remains at the most dovish end of the scale.

key_quotes.quote: La Junta de Gobierno estima que hacia delante podría continuar con la calibración de la postura monetaria y considerar ajustarla en magnitud similar.
key_quotes.context: Explicit guidance that another 50bp cut is on the table

key_quotes.quote: Prevé que el entorno inflacionario permita seguir con el ciclo de recortes a la tasa de referencia, si bien manteniendo una postura restrictiva.
key_quotes.context: Cutting cycle continues as the base case, stance still restrictive

key_quotes.quote: El entorno de incertidumbre y de tensiones comerciales implica importantes riesgos a la baja.
key_quotes.context: Weak activity and downside risks from trade tensions

key_quotes.quote: Se considera que el balance de riesgos respecto de la trayectoria prevista para la inflación en el horizonte de pronóstico, si bien se mantiene sesgado al alza, ha mejorado conforme los choques globales se han ido resolviendo.
key_quotes.context: Upside risk tilt persists but has improved -- inflation not a brake on easing
